essence: Placing thus on the left hand constitutes the eighteenth placement.
Placement on the fingertip and thumb beginning constitutes the nineteenth placement.
Placement on the pair of arms and joints constitutes the twenty-first placement.
Placement on the genitals, knee, and foot is declared as the twenty-second placement.
This pair placement is called the twenty-third in number.
